items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Acid Flask (Greater) (Infused)
items.description:
Activate Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 3d6 persistent acid damage, and 3 acid splash damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Greater) (Infused)
items.description:
Activate Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 3d8 fire damage, 3 persistent fire damage, and 3 fire splash damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Bottled Lightning (Greater) (Infused)
items.description:
Activate Strike

Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they are exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals 3d6 electricity damage and 3 electricity splash damage. On a hit, the target becomes Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Frost Vial (Greater) (Infused)
items.description:
Activate Strike

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold splash damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls, the bomb deals 3d6 cold damage and 3 cold splash damage, and the target takes a -10-foot penalty.

items.name: Explorer's Clothing
items.description: Adventurers who don't wear armor travel in durable clothing. Though it's not armor and uses your unarmored defense proficiency, it still has a Dex Cap and can grant an item bonus to AC if etched with potency runes.

items.name: Dragon Bile (Applied to Body)
items.description:
A mix of digestive juices and green dragon poison glands nauseates the victim as its flesh is digested from within.

Activate Interact (Contact)

Saving Throw DC 37 Fortitude

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 6d6 poison damage and Sickened 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 7d6 poison damage and sickened 3 (1 round)

Stage 3 9d6 poison damage and sickened 4 (1 round)

items.name: Blightburn Resin (Infused)
items.description:
This tacky, hardened sap is harvested from trees infected by fungal blights and exposed to open flames.

Activate Interact (Contact)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 8d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 10d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 3 15d6 poison damage (1 round)

items.name: Deathcap Powder (Infused)
items.description:
The toxic deathcap mushroom can be dried, ground, and treated to form a flavorless powder with accelerated effects.

Activate Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 6 minutes

Stage 1 13d6 poison damage (1 minute)

Stage 2 17d6 poison damage and Sickened 2 (1 minute)

Stage 3 20d6 poison damage and sickened 3 (1 minute)

items.name: Elixir of Life (Greater) (Infused)
items.description:
Activate Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature''s natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain 7d6+18 healing Hit Points and gain +2 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

items.name: Malyass Root Paste (Infused)
items.description:
Malyass root paste sees use to impede opponents in athletic competitions, in addition to espionage and tracking.

Activate Interact (Contact)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 6 minutes

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 and -10-foot status penalty to all Speeds (1 minute)

Stage 2 clumsy 2 and -20-foot status penalty to all Speeds (1 minute)

Stage 3 clumsy 3, Off-Guard, and -30-foot status penalty to all Speeds

items.name: Purple Worm Venom (Infused)
items.description:
Venom from enormous purple worms leaves a victim weakened.

Activate Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 5d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

items.name: Shadow Essence (Infused)
items.description:
Distilled from the Plane of Shadow, this oily substance imposes tenebrous effects. The enfeebled condition from shadow essence lasts for 24 hours.

Activate Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 void damage and 2d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 3d6 void damage, 2d6 poison damage, and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d6 void damage, 2d6 poison damage, and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

items.name: Spider Root (Infused)
items.description:
A paste made by mashing the fine, threadlike roots of a certain creeper vine, spider root renders a victim clumsy and maladroit.

Activate Interact (Contact)

Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude save

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 6 minutes

Stage 1 8d6 poison damage and Clumsy 1 (1 minute)

Stage 2 9d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 minute)

Stage 3 10d6 poison damage and clumsy 3 (1 minute)

defensiveAbilities.name: Poisoned Coat
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature adjacent to Blue Viper hits him with a melee unarmed Strike.

Effect The triggering creature is exposed to Dragon Bile. This consumes the poison, and Blue Viper can't use Poisoned Coat again until he spends 10 minutes applying one dose of contact or injury poison to his clothing.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pinpoint Poisoner
offensiveAbilities.description: When Blue Viper successfully Strikes an Off-Guard creature with a poisoned weapon or exposes an off-guard creature to an inhaled poison, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its initial save against that poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Spray
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Blue Viper is holding a contact or injury poison.

Effect Blue Viper swigs the poison and sprays it out of his mouth, affecting a 15 foot cone. Blue Viper isn't exposed to the poison. All creatures in the cone are immediately exposed to the poison and each creature must attempt a Fortitude save against the poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Potent Poisoner
offensiveAbilities.description: Blue Viper's infused poisons have a DC of 34.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Application
offensiveAbilities.description: Blue Viper Interacts to draw an injury poison and applies it to a weapon he is holding.
